contract.name: TestPrincipalPlugin
contract.desc:
TEST-ONLY. Installable ARC-58 plugin for the principal-resolution suite
(docs/principal-resolution/PHASE-0-SPEC.md §5.1). Every method takes the wallet first
(`appArgs(1) == W`, required by the wallet's window pinning). Never deploy outside tests.

methods.name: callProbe
methods.desc:
`probe.probe(hint)` sent as the wallet's spending account S; rekeys S back when `rekeyBack`.
NON-COMPLIANT on purpose: it forwards a caller-chosen `hint` (§3.8 rule 6 violation) so the suite can
aim any hint at the open window. A shipping plugin forwards `windowHint(wallet)` (see `callProbeWindow`).

methods.name: callProbeWindow
methods.desc:
T47 positive control: the compliant shape (§3.8 rule 6). The hint is `windowHint(wallet)`, the
wallet whose window this call serves, never a caller-supplied value. Compare `callProbe`, whose
caller-chosen `hint` is the T47 negative control.

methods.name: callProbeCost
methods.desc: T32: `probe.probeCost(hint)` sent as S: opcode cost of the strict resolution in the target.

methods.name: callProbeAuth
methods.desc: V0.1: `probe.probeAuth(hint)` sent as S, returning what the callee sees as S.authAddress.

methods.name: callProbeAsSelf
methods.desc: E11/T16: the plugin calls the probe as ITS OWN address with hint W, then rekeys S back.

methods.name: callTryProbeAsSelf
methods.desc: T27: `tryProbe` as the plugin's own address, then rekeys S back.

methods.name: proxyProbe
methods.desc:
E9/T14 proxy chain (compliant P): rekey S to `proxy` in the SAME inner group as the proxy call
(§3.8 rule 3(b)); the proxy probes as S and hands S back to this plugin before it returns.

methods.name: proxyProbeKeep
methods.desc: Negative control: the proxy is told to KEEP S (§3.8 rule 3(b) violation).

methods.name: principal
methods.desc: T30: the plugin-side answer (`pluginPrincipal`) for this wallet. Call before S is rekeyed back.

methods.name: callRelay
methods.desc: E12/T17: sending as S, call `probe.relay(probe2, hint)`; probe2 then sees caller = probe.

methods.name: callReenter
methods.desc:
V0.2/T23: mid-window call-out to `MockPrincipalReenter.poke(this, forgedWallet, probe)`, which
tries to re-enter this plugin with a forged wallet. The AVM rejects the re-entry.

methods.name: callOwns
methods.desc: T28 "escrow mid-window": `probe.owns(wallet.id, account)` while the window is open.

methods.name: callCtxOwns
methods.desc:
T38–T40: `probe.probeCtx(hint)` as S (no rekey), then in the same window `probe.ctxOwns(ctx, account)`
and, when `alsoThirdParty`, `probe.thirdParty(account, hint)` for the E23 comparison.

methods.name: callTipWallet
methods.desc: T48: `probe.tipWalletOf(creator, stored)` while the window is open (E23: a held creator gets 0).

methods.name: done
methods.desc: Hand S back to the wallet (closes a window opened with rekeyBack = false).
